_notes: Deterministic Journey B fixture — no random data. Codes follow the catalog barcode rule (>=4 digits, no leading zero, unique). These records exist on dev staging (discovered-not-recreated by src/utils/api/officeFixture.ts) and are the codes the XML import tests reference in their envelopes.
field2/job2 are B2's crew-move destinations. mealJob is B10's meal job — a meal punch is an ordinary Time In whose Job is this one (Amy's device shows it as '0 - LUNCH').
Sticker employees are one per workflow so they never share an employee-day under workers=2: 6005 -> B6, 6006 -> B5, 6007 -> B7.

b4.packHouseRoll (POST /scan/assign-barcode-roll) is deliberately FIXED: the write is an upsert, so one permanent code-history row on employee 6006 across every run — see the B4 plan's Cleanup section. The device-side roll codes in B4-001 are run-unique instead (EmployeeCodeHistory has no delete endpoint).
Each workflow's fixture day (DAY_OFFSET) is NOT here: every scenario file carries its own dayOffset and scenarioLoader asserts they stay pairwise distinct.
